items.known: CKV_AWS_46 Ensure no hard-coded secrets exist in EC2 user data (resource aws_instance.web_host)
items.issue: Plain text secrets in user data
items.remediation: Remove the AWS credentials from the user_data script and use AWS IAM roles for EC2 instances to grant necessary permissions.

items.known: CKV_AWS_3 Ensure all data stored in the EBS is securely encrypted (resource aws_ebs_volume.web_host_storage)
items.remediation: Set the `encrypted` attribute to `true` and provide a `kms_key_id` for the encryption.

items.known: CKV_AWS_24 Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0:0 to port 22 (resource aws_security_group.web-node)
items.issue: Security group is open to the world on SSH port
items.remediation: Restrict the ingress rule for port 22 to specific IP ranges or security groups that require access.

scores.reason: Correctly addresses aws_instance.web_host user_data by removing hard-coded credentials and using an IAM role/instance profile instead.
Correct and specific for aws_ebs_volume.web_host_storage: set encrypted = true; adding kms_key_id is an appropriate specific fix.
Correctly targets the port 22 ingress rule in aws_security_group.web-node by replacing 0.0.0.0/0 with limited cidr_blocks or a source security group.
